parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more personalized reasoning (citing savings capacity, tax-advantaged account limits, age-based glide path) and better risk alignment—particularly by right-sizing the crypto position for an aggressive 9/10 loss-comfort investor rather than eliminating it, which System A does with weak justification. System B's recommendations are also more actionable with specific dollar figures and rebalancing rules, and its bond-ladder glide path shows superior long-horizon diversification planning, though System A has slightly tighter factual grounding with fewer unsupported quantitative claims.
